title: Manual Fabric deployment parameter contract
description: Defines the inputs a customer (or operator) supplies after manually provisioning a Microsoft Fabric workspace + Lakehouse. The manual path is built and proven FIRST (Decision 3): if these parameters drive a working end-to-end run, the automated REST provisioning script becomes a convenience layer over a known-good path rather than a single point of failure. The preflight validator loads this schema and FAILS LOUDLY on any malformed or inconsistent value before any pipeline runs.

workspaceName.description: Display name of the manually-created Fabric workspace.

lakehouseName.description: Name of the managed Lakehouse created in the workspace. Letters, digits, underscore; must start with a letter (Fabric naming rule).

oneLakeEndpoint.description: ABFSS path to the Lakehouse in OneLake. Form: abfss://{workspace}@onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/{lakehouse}.Lakehouse. For Microsoft-internal (msit) tenants the host is msit-onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com. The notebooks write managed Delta here (Decision 2). Must be the OneLake DFS endpoint, never a blob endpoint.

sqlEndpoint.description: SQL analytics endpoint host for the Lakehouse. Power BI connects here first (Decision 4: SQL endpoint before DirectLake). Host only, no scheme or database suffix. For Microsoft-internal (msit) tenants the suffix is .msit-datawarehouse.fabric.microsoft.com.

capacityId.description: Optional. Fabric capacity resource id backing the workspace. Recorded for traceability; not required for the manual path.

environment.description: Deployment environment label. Restricted to non-production while the manual path is being proven.
